comment: Example room set (roadmap F11, recomposed with motifs in F11b): five halves written by tools/templates/make_rooms.py, used only by the scenario room_sets (Hyrule Castle and the Castle Basement with RoomSet Example). The outline is in pixels of the half room (256 wide, 128 or 256 tall), on the 8 px grid; the half is the top of the room and the converter joins it with a flipped half below. The decoration comes from the motifs of data/room-templates/motifs.json (tools/templates/motifs.py --report lists them): each half names the motifs that make its function, the other layers take the most used motif of the shared templates.

halves.name: Hall
halves.comment: Great hall with every door, hosting the four kinds of section: lamps and statues in the top corners, pot rows along the top wall, a full carpet.

halves.name: Notched
halves.comment: Pool room with the top corners cut away (like template 11139): one statue in the narrow top, lamps in the notch corners, a pool on the middle line that the bottom half mirrors.

halves.name: Gallery
halves.comment: Tall half (the joined room is 1x2): statues and lamps along the side walls, spike strips at their feet, treasure spots down the middle; hosts the four kinds of section.

halves.name: Basin
halves.comment: Tall room on the lower floor (the joined room is 1x2) around a basin: water down the middle line and on both sides of it below the side doors, lamps and statues in the corners.

halves.name: Vault
halves.comment: Plain room on the lower floor with every lower door; it names no motif, so every layer takes the motif the shared templates use most.

halves.name: Ledges
halves.comment: Lower floor with its top corners cut (like template 40419): the upper walls follow it 24 px out; spikes guard the corners.
